description: Paid ($0.05 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): diagnoses your x402 endpoint, then returns per problem the concrete change as code for your stack (express, next, hono, node, python, generic), filled in with your own payTo, amount, network and route. For the endpoint's owner: includes the diagnosis, so there is no need to call x402_diagnose first. Same as GET /api/v1/fix. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_fix

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

fixes.description: Each problem with steps and code for your stack

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the answer to your arguments

title: Fix plan for an x402 endpoint ($0.05 via x402)
